"""Check the native app update persisted without changing the existing schedule."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, time, tomllib

T = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
R = T / 'MOD4_H1_FUDAN133_LINE_Z_RESOURCE_V134_20261030/reports'

def main():
    p = Path('C:/Users/lulu/.codex/automations/mod4-10/automation.toml')
    b = p.read_bytes()
    x = tomllib.loads(b.decode('utf8'))
    request = json.loads((R / 'AUTOMATION_CURRENT134_UPDATE_REQUEST.json').read_bytes())
    receipt = json.loads((R / 'AUTOMATION_CURRENT134_NATIVE_APP_RECEIPT.json').read_bytes())
    assert not receipt.get('isError')
    assert x['prompt'].rstrip('\n') == request['prompt'].rstrip('\n')
    original = dict(version=1, id='mod4-10', kind='heartbeat', name='MOD4计划与双机并行巡检',
        status='ACTIVE', rrule='FREQ=HOURLY;INTERVAL=1',
        target_thread_id='01a07a2d-9036-7531-a012-692df9f56353', created_at=1790754159816)
    assert all(x[k] == v for k, v in original.items())
    assert x['updated_at'] > 1793312260632
    v = dict(passed=True, epoch=time.time(), path=str(p), bytes=len(b),
        SHA=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), prompt_equal_ignoring_final_LF_only=True,
        requested_prompt_chars=len(request['prompt']), original_fields_unchanged=original,
        actual_updated_at=x['updated_at'], native_app_receipt_passed=True,
        no_new_automation_or_Goal=True, no_schedule_target_or_created_at_change=True,
        no_SSH_model_raw_or_GPU_action=True)
    with (R / 'AUTOMATION_CURRENT134_PERSISTED_CHECK.json').open('xb') as out:
        out.write((json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf8'))
    print(json.dumps(v, ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__ == '__main__':
